text:
Alex W: heads-up — saw a weird drop in prefix hit-rate for kv-cache on prod, ~95% -> ~82% over the last 30m. Anyone know which dashboard/panels to look at? Also what quick logs/traces should I pull? :thinking:
Infra Bot: [alert] kv-prefix-hitrate-prod: variance above threshold, fired at 2026-03-17T09:02:03Z :warning:
Maria K: Grafana: https://grafana.redwood.company/d/abcd123/kv-caches?orgId=1 — panels to check: 'Prefix hit-rate (by route)', 'KV hit heatmap', 'Prefetch sampling rate'. Start with last 1h range.
Maria K: PromQL I usually run for aggregate hit-rate: `sum(rate(kv_prefetch_hits_total[5m])) / sum(rate(kv_requests_total[5m]))`
Alex W: thanks — do we have a quick Loki query to surface missy prefetched requests or traces to attach? Not sure who owns this alert either. :eyes:
Jonathan P: @Maria K owns kv observability dashboards, @SRE Oncall owns alert thresholds. Loki snippet that helps:
```
{job="kvcache"} |= "prefix_hit=false" | json | line_format "{route} {prefetch=true}" 
```
Maria K: also try this Loki filter to find prefetch errors:
```
{app="kvcache"} |= "prefetch_error" | logfmt
```
Maria K: If you want route-level metrics in Grafana, try the panel query: `topk(20, sum by(route)(rate(kv_prefix_hits_total[5m])) / sum by(route)(rate(kv_prefix_requests_total[5m])))` — that'll show top bad actors.
SRE Oncall: i'll keep an eye. alert currently fires on a sustained 4% drop over 10m. If it's noisy we can mute briefly while you triage, but prefer snapshot first.
Alex W: snapshot attached (will add to ticket) — looks concentrated around route `/chat/generate` and a couple of sub-prefixes.
Jonathan P: i'll pull traces for that route now. quick checks: 1) prefetch sampler ratio 2) evictions (`kv_prefix_evictions_total`) 3) any recent rollout to the model that increases variance.
Maria K: eviction spikes often cause these. PromQL for evictions: `increase(kv_prefix_evictions_total[15m])`
Alex W: ok collecting logs + trace ids, will update here. @Maria K can you confirm dashboard owners for follow-up? cc @Jonathan P
Maria K: owners: panels -> @Maria K, dashboard steward -> @Infra Bot. Filed follow-up: https://linear.redwood.com/issue/RD-4023 assigned to eng-platform for deeper sleuth.
SRE Oncall: thanks — i'll leave alert as-is for now and watch the ticket. :thumbsup:
